item.tib: khra ther dbang bsdud dbus phyogs
item.coloph: mkha' 'gro gnad kyi gdams pa la/ khra ther drag po'i dmigs pa 'di/ skal ldan khyod la snyan du brgyud/ gsang sbas thabs la mkhas par gyis/ u ya ag tham/ sa ma ya rgya rgya rgya/ dad ldan grogs po'i rkyen gyis bskul ba'i ngor/ dkar chags (chag) yi ge ris su bris pa 'di/ rig 'dzin mkha' 'gro rnams la bzod par gsol/ dge ba'i 'gro kun rig 'dzin sa thob shog/
